linkedin:
Most people who say ChatGPT is useless for marketing have only ever typed one vague line into it.

The tool isn't the problem. The brief is.

When I train marketing teams, the biggest shift comes from one habit: giving ChatGPT a role, context, a clear task, a format and an example. The output goes from generic to genuinely usable.

So I've put together 20 copy ready prompts grouped by the jobs marketers do every week: ad copy, social posts, email, SEO briefs, customer research, campaign ideas and reporting. There are local examples too, like a café in Port Louis and a boutique in Curepipe.

I've also covered the limits. OpenAI itself warns that ChatGPT can sound confident and still be wrong, so every output is a first draft. Keep your brand voice. And never paste customer personal data or confidential information into a prompt.

Used well, it's leverage. Used badly, it's extra work.
